question: India was the global host of 2018 World Environment Day (5th June). The theme that year was:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Beat Plastic Pollution**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The theme for the 2018 World Environment Day was "Beat Plastic Pollution". India hosted the event on June 5, 2018. 
 
• The theme called for governments, businesses, communities, and individuals to: 
 
• Reduce the production and use of single-use plastic 
 
• Explore sustainable alternatives 
 
• Raise awareness of the threat plastic pollution poses to human health and marine life 
 
• The United Nations has celebrated World Environment Day since 1974 to encourage global action and awareness to protect the environment. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• The United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) is the leading global environmental authority that sets the global environmental agenda, promotes the coherent implementation of the environmental dimension of sustainable development within the United Nations system, and serves as an authoritative advocate for the global environment. 
 
• In 2019, China was the global host of World Environment Day celebrations on the theme of Air Pollution.
 
• The theme of the 2021 year’s World Environment Day is Ecosystem Restoration. Pakistan will act as the global host of the day.
 
• World Environment Day 2021 will see the launch of the UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration.
